The '''Suwanee Pirates''' were a gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that operated in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The gang was led by [[Gideon (Devaronian)|Gideon]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]], and was based on the [[TL-1200 transport/Legends|TL-1200 transport]] ''[[Fereallis]]''.<ref name="LoNH" />
